still_act1_stairs.png:
Torch-lit stone dungeon floor of a tower, right after a battle. In a corner lies a big defeated monster as a vague dark heap with little swirl marks above it (no specific creature). In the back wall a hidden stone staircase has just been revealed, warm golden light and faint wisps of steam from cooked food drifting down from above. The small grey tabby ninja cat stands at the bottom, looking up the stairs, sniffing the air with a curious face. Warm orange and brown palette.

still_act2_moonstairs.png:
Night. A beam of pale moonlight falls through a crack in the tower roof and lands on the last stone staircase, which climbs up out of the wooden floor toward the open night sky and a stone parapet above. The small grey tabby ninja cat stands small at the bottom step, seen from behind, headband tails fluttering in the wind. Big full moon and stars visible through the opening. Cool blue palette, quiet and hopeful.
